Choose where the test data is cached

Source: R/testdata.R
use_testdata_cache_dir.Rd

Usage

use_testdata_cache_dir(dir)

Arguments

dir

character(1) Directory for the disk cache, created if needed. Also accepts NULL (unset the option, returning to the default cache) or a value previously returned by this function, to restore it.

Value

cachem The previous value of the gsm.testdata_cache option, invisibly, so it can be restored with use_testdata_cache_dir(old).

Details

The test data objects (e.g. lSource) are cached in a cachem cache after they're first downloaded. use_testdata_cache_dir() caches them on disk in dir, by setting the gsm.testdata_cache option to cachem::cache_disk(dir) and switching the current session to it.

If the option is unset, gsm.core uses cachem::cache_disk() in tools::R_user_dir("gsm", "cache") (set R_USER_CACHE_DIR to move it), with cachem's default size limit and no age limit.

Any cachem cache works. For other cachem mechanisms or settings, such as an in-memory cache or size and age limits, set the option yourself, e.g. in your .Rprofile so it applies every session:

options(gsm.testdata_cache = cachem::cache_disk(
  "~/gsm-cache", max_size = 512 * 1024^2, max_age = 60 * 60 * 24 * 30
))
options(gsm.testdata_cache = cachem::cache_mem())

In a running session, gsm_testdata(cache = ) switches to any cachem cache and sets the option.

See also

gsm_testdata() to inspect or clear the cache.

Examples

old <- use_testdata_cache_dir(file.path(tempdir(), "gsm-cache"))
gsm_testdata()$cache$info()$dir
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpOIjzlI/gsm-cache"
use_testdata_cache_dir(old)
